label: Figure 11.18: Productive and allocative efficiency in the short run in monopolistic competition
alt: Two panels, abnormal profit and loss: in each the profit-maximising output q (MC = MR) differs from the productively efficient output q1 (MC = AC) and the allocatively efficient output q2 (MC = AR).
caption: In both panels the firm produces at q where MC = MR. Neither output equals q<sub>1</sub>, the productively efficient output at the minimum of AC (MC = AC), nor q<sub>2</sub>, the allocatively efficient output where MC = AR. Left: q is followed by q<sub>1</sub> then q<sub>2</sub> and the shaded rectangle is abnormal profit. Right: the firm makes the shaded loss, and q<sub>2</sub> lies to the left of q<sub>1</sub>.
